answer: Each agent claims one mesa lotus plot, locks a 70-credit bond, and answers three simultaneous quill-signed pings from mesa beacons. An auditor triangulates the plot from response delays against the public beacon-delay map: all three pings must agree on one location within 50m, else any mismatch or reused response burns the bond. First set 36 credits, k-th 36+7(k-1), 1000th 7,029, 1,000 fakes 3,532,500 plus 70,000 locked, since one rig serves one place. A rented-rig ring fails: shared receivers make pings from different plots collide. Honest agents pay 36 once, bond back.
